basis: The plotted data for 'New Tourists' in Town Z shows a clear upward trend from 1880 to 1891. The line starts near 1,000 in 1880 and ends near 3,000 in 1891, with the 1891 endpoint significantly higher than the 1880 start. Although the chart title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists,' the visual evidence of the plotted series contradicts this text. In the absence of an explicit policy prioritizing the title over the data, the plotted trend is the primary evidence for the 'tourism trend routing decision.' The data indicates growth over the review period.
